GOOSE_MAX_TOKENS.description: Maximum number of tokens for each model response (truncates longer responses)

GOOSE_CACHE_TTL.description: Anthropic prompt-cache TTL; `1h` keeps the cached prefix alive across idle gaps at a higher cache-write rate. Headless runs always use `5m`

GOOSE_MAX_TURNS.description: [Maximum number of turns](/docs/guides/sessions/smart-context-management#maximum-turns) allowed without user input

GOOSE_INPUT_LIMIT.description: Override input token limit for Ollama (maps to `num_ctx`)

GOOSE_CLI_LIGHT_THEME.description: Custom syntax highlighting theme for light mode

GOOSE_CLI_DARK_THEME.description: Custom syntax highlighting theme for dark mode

GOOSE_CLI_SHOW_COST.description: Show estimated cost for token use in the CLI

GOOSE_CLI_BELL.description: Ring the terminal bell when an interactive turn finishes or tool approval is required

GOOSE_DOCS_ROOT.description: Documentation root used by `goose-doc-guide` (e.g. for offline/air-gapped docs)

GOOSE_AUTO_COMPACT_THRESHOLD.description: Set the percentage threshold at which goose [automatically compacts your session](/docs/guides/sessions/smart-context-management#automatic-compaction).

SECURITY_PROMPT_ENABLED.description: Enable [prompt injection detection](/docs/guides/security/prompt-injection-detection) to identify potentially harmful commands

SECURITY_PROMPT_THRESHOLD.description: Sensitivity threshold for prompt injection detection (higher = stricter)

SECURITY_PROMPT_CLASSIFIER_ENABLED.description: Enable ML-based prompt injection detection for advanced threat identification

SECURITY_PROMPT_CLASSIFIER_ENDPOINT.description: Classification endpoint URL for ML-based prompt injection detection
